mapper.select: SELECT sd.id, sd.dept_code AS deptCode, sd.dept_name AS deptName, sud.is_primary AS isPrimary, sud.created_at AS joinedAt FROM sys_user_department sud INNER JOIN sys_department sd ON sud.department_id = sd.id AND sd.deleted = 0 WHERE sud.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sud.is_primary DESC, sud.created_at ASC

SELECT sd.id, sd.dept_code AS deptCode, sd.dept_name AS deptName, sud.is_primary AS isPrimary, sud.created_at AS joinedAt FROM sys_user_department sud INNER JOIN sys_department sd ON sud.department_id = sd.id AND sd.deleted = 0 WHERE sud.user_id = #{userId} AND sud.is_primary = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT su.id, su.username, su.real_name AS realName, sud.is_primary AS isPrimary, sud.created_at AS joinedAt FROM sys_user_department sud INNER JOIN sys_user su ON sud.user_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE sud.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY sud.is_primary DESC, sud.created_at ASC
